# M005-S04-T07: Frontend auth types and login API proxy

## Why
Frontend needs TypeScript types for auth and a way to call the login endpoint. The API proxy pattern follows S01 conventions.

## Do
1. Update src/types/fastapi.ts:
   - Add LoginRequest { username: string; password: string }
   - Add LoginResponse { access_token: string; token_type: string; role: string }
   - Add User { id: number; username: string; role: string }
   - Add UserRole type: 'owner' | 'manager' | 'warehouse'
2. Create src/app/api/auth/login/route.ts:
   - POST handler that proxies to FastAPI /api/auth/login
   - Transform error responses per S01 pattern
3. Update src/lib/api-client.ts:
   - Add getAuthToken() helper to read JWT from localStorage
   - Add setAuthToken(token) helper to store JWT
   - Modify apiFetch to include Authorization header from localStorage
4. Create src/lib/auth.ts with:
   - login(username, password) function
   - isAuthenticated() check
   - getUserRole() helper

## Done when
- Frontend can call /api/auth/login and receive JWT
- Token is stored in localStorage
- API client includes Authorization header in requests

## Inputs

- `src/types/fastapi.ts`
- `src/lib/api-client.ts`

## Expected Output

- `src/types/fastapi.ts`
- `src/app/api/auth/login/route.ts`

1→import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server'
     2→import { apiFetch } from '@/lib/api-client'
     3→import type { ProjectResponse, ProjectCreate, ProjectUpdate } from '@/types/fastapi'
     4→
     5→// =============================================================================
     6→// Type Mappings
     7→// =============================================================================
     8→
     9→// Prisma (old) -> FastAPI (new) status mappings
    10→const STATUS_TO_FASTAPI: Record<string, string> = {
    11→  'new': 'Проектирование',
    12→  'processing': 'Закупки',
    13→  'paid': 'Оплачено',
    14→  'delivered': 'Доставлено',
    15→}
    16→
    17→const STATUS_FROM_FASTAPI: Record<string, string> = {
    18→  'Проектирование': 'new',
    19→  'Закупки': 'processing',
    20→  'Оплачено': 'paid',
    21→  'Доставлено': 'delivered',
    22→}
    23→
    24→// =============================================================================
    25→// Helper Functions
    26→// =============================================================================
    27→
    28→/**
    29→ * Transform FastAPI snake_case response to camelCase for frontend compatibility
    30→ */
    31→function toCamelCase(obj: any): any {
    32→  if (obj === null || obj === undefined) return obj
    33→  if (Array.isArray(obj)) return obj.map(toCamelCase)
    34→  if (typeof obj !== 'object') return obj
    35→
    36→  const result: Record<string, any> = {}
    37→  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(obj)) {
    38→    // Map snake_case to camelCase
    39→    const camelKey = key.replace(/_([a-z])/g, (_, letter) => letter.toUpperCase())
    40→
    41→    // Special field mappings for Prisma compatibility
    42→    let mappedKey = camelKey
    43→    let mappedValue = value
    44→
    45→    if (key === 'client') {
    46→      mappedKey = 'customerName'
    47→    } else if (key === 'total_cost') {
    48→      mappedKey = 'totalCost'
    49→    } else if (key === 'created_at') {
    50→      mappedKey = 'createdAt'
    51→    } else if (key === 'updated_at') {
    52→      mappedKey = 'updatedAt'
    53→    }
    54→
    55→    // Status mapping (FastAPI Russian -> English)
    56→    if (key === 'status' && typeof value === 'string') {
    57→      mappedValue = STATUS_FROM_FASTAPI[value] || value
    58→    }
    59→
    60→    // Recurse for nested objects
    61→    if (typeof mappedValue === 'object' && mappedValue !== null) {
    62→      mappedValue = toCamelCase(mappedValue)
    63→    }
    64→
    65→    result[mappedKey] = mappedValue
    66→  }
    67→  return result
    68→}
    69→
    70→/**
    71→ * Transform camelCase request body to snake_case for FastAPI
    72→ */
    73→function toSnakeCase(obj: any): any {
    74→  if (obj === null || obj === undefined) return obj
    75→  if (Array.isArray(obj)) return obj.map(toSnakeCase)
    76→  if (typeof obj !== 'object') return obj
    77→
    78→  const result: Record<string, any> = {}
    79→  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(obj)) {
    80→    // camelCase to snake_case
    81→    const snakeKey = key.replace(/[A-Z]/g, letter => `_${letter.toLowerCase()}`)
    82→
    83→    // Special field mappings
    84→    let mappedKey = snakeKey
    85→    let mappedValue = value
    86→
    87→    if (key === 'customerName') {
    88→      mappedKey = 'client'
    89→    } else if (key === 'totalCost') {
    90→      mappedKey = 'total_cost'
    91→    }
    92→
    93→    // Status mapping (English -> FastAPI Russian)
    94→    if (key === 'status' && typeof value === 'string') {
    95→      mappedValue = STATUS_TO_FASTAPI[value] || value
    96→    }
    97→
    98→    // Recurse for nested objects
    99→    if (typeof mappedValue === 'object' && mappedValue !== null) {
   100→      mappedValue = toSnakeCase(mappedValue)
   101→    }
   102→
   103→    result[mappedKey] = mappedValue
   104→  }
   105→  return result
   106→}

   108→// =============================================================================
   109→// GET /api/projects - List projects
   110→// =============================================================================
   111→
   112→export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
   113→  try {
   114→    const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url)
   115→    const status = searchParams.get('status')
   116→    const search = searchParams.get('search')
   117→    const skip = searchParams.get('skip')
   118→    const limit = searchParams.get('limit')
   119→
   120→    const params: Record<string, string | number> = {}
   121→    if (skip) params.skip = parseInt(skip, 10)
   122→    if (limit) params.limit = parseInt(limit, 10)
   123→    if (status) {
   124→      // Map English status to Russian for FastAPI
   125→      params.status = STATUS_TO_FASTAPI[status] || status
   126→    }
   127→    if (search) params.search = search
   128→
   129→    const result = await apiFetch<ProjectResponse[]>('/api/projects', { params })
   130→
   131→    if (result.error) {
   132→      const statusCode = (result.error.details as any)?.status || 500
   133→      return NextResponse.json(
   134→        { error: result.error.error, details: result.error.details },
   135→        { status: statusCode }
   136→      )
   137→    }
   138→
   139→    // Transform to camelCase for frontend
   140→    const transformed = toCamelCase(result.data)
   141→
   142→    // Add _count for compatibility with existing frontend
   143→    const withCounts = Array.isArray(transformed)
   144→      ? (transformed as any[]).map((project: any) => ({
   145→          ...project,
   146→          _count: { items: project.items?.length || 0 },
   147→        }))
   148→      : transformed
   149→
   150→    return NextResponse.json(withCounts)
   151→  } catch (error) {
   152→    console.error('Projects list error:', error)
   153→    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Failed to fetch projects' }, { status: 500 })
   154→  }
   155→}
   156→
   157→// =============================================================================
   158→// POST /api/projects - Create project
   159→// =============================================================================
   160→
   161→export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
   162→  try {
   163→    const body = await request.json()
   164→    const { name, customerName, description, fileData, fileName } = body
   165→
   166→    if (!name || !name.trim()) {
   167→      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Project name is required' }, { status: 400 })
   168→    }
   169→
   170→    // Handle Excel file upload (parseExcelFile from frontend)
   171→    // For now, we create project without items via FastAPI
   172→    // Excel parsing will be migrated to FastAPI in a future task
   173→    const projectData: ProjectCreate = {
   174→      name: name.trim(),
   175→      client: customerName?.trim() || '',
   176→      status: STATUS_TO_FASTAPI.new,
   177→      total_cost: null,
   178→    }
   179→
   180→    const result = await apiFetch<ProjectResponse>('/api/projects', {
   181→      method: 'POST',
   182→      body: projectData,
   183→    })
   184→
   185→    if (result.error) {
   186→      const statusCode = (result.error.details as any)?.status || 500
   187→      return NextResponse.json(
   188→        { error: result.error.error, details: result.error.details },
   189→        { status: statusCode }
   190→      )
   191→    }
   192→
   193→    // Transform response to camelCase
   194→    const transformed = toCamelCase(result.data)
   195→    const responseWithCount = {
   196→      ...transformed,
   197→      _count: { items: 0 },
   198→    }
   199→
   200→    return NextResponse.json(responseWithCount, { status: 201 })
   201→  } catch (error) {
   202→    console.error('Project create error:', error)
   203→    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Failed to create project' }, { status: 500 })
   204→  }
   205→}
